| `gsap.min.js` | GSAP 3.15.0, GreenSock | GSAP Standard "No Charge" License, https://gsap.com/standard-license (the `@license` header is kept in the file) |

| `lenis.min.js` | Lenis 1.3.26, darkroom.engineering | MIT, text in `lenis.LICENSE.txt` (the minified file carries no header) |
